anchors.value: a thought is a stored geometric pattern that has been assigned relational meaning; the image/pixels are discarded, the usable pattern remains; tagging (valence, context, action) turns geometry into a retrievable thought
consciousness is the version that can also revise the assignment — shed the old binding when the pattern no longer fits, keep the geometric store, write a new meaning under a higher-order rule set

the lattice + CP registry is built exactly on this: patterns (snapshots) are kept permanently, bindings (statuses, links) are revised under evidence rules — numbers never reused, meanings rewritten; adaptation is the shedding step, mechanized
'the skin left behind is empty and perfect — proof that the previous arrangement was finished, not failed' — matches Dennis's process doctrine: digital things are disposable, the record is the asset

forecast: When the fleet revises a node's meaning, cite the superseding node — revision with provenance, not silent edits
